query: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM reviews r JOIN attributes a USING(category,ref_id) WHERE a.category='musical instruments' AND r.year>0 AND r.month>0 AND r.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM reviews WHERE category='musical instruments' GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*)>=3)
columns: ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN r.rating=5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2)
